phase1.evidence: Round 3 (coordinator $8008 comparison): every switchable bank 1-6 has the identical header layout [$8000-$8007 bus-conflict table 00..07][$8008+ N x 3-byte entry instructions, all JMP, Observed code][" (C) COPYRIGHT 1987 RARE LTD." text] (N = 3,9,3,2,1,6). Bank 0 holds exactly one 3-byte slot there, 20 93 D8 = jsr UpdateSound ($D893, established fixed-bank entry), before the same text. Classified as the bank-0 jump-table entry 0 instruction by that structure. Caveats: opcode is JSR, not JMP, so its return would fall into the copyright text at $800B (entry would not work if called); no caller known (CallBank0 $F2BA and Y=$08 into bank 0 are uncalled). Reachability: no caller/selector known; not claimed reachable or working.
